name: Scholomance (Classic)
summary: In the Western Plaguelands, Scholomance trains mortal spellcasters in the Scourge's arts. The academy lies beneath Caer Darrow, hidden in the crypts of the island fortress.

sections.title: A School in the Tombs
sections.body:
Before the Third War laid Lordaeron waste, the rogue archmage Kel'Thuzad sought recruits for his Cult of the Damned. The wealthy Barov family ruled Caer Darrow and became willing benefactors. They traded their lands and crypts for promised immortality. The cult instead slaughtered them and raised them as monstrous undead.

Beneath the ruined fortress, the cult remade the ancient Arathorian catacombs into a school for the dark arts. Mortal acolytes study plaguecraft, soul binding, and flesh shaping beyond watchful eyes. There, they hone the foul magic that shattered Lordaeron.

sections.title: Lich and Headmaster
sections.body:
Kel'Thuzad now directs Scourge operations from above, but Scholomance remains active. The eternal lich Ras Frostwhisper watches over the complex in the Scourge's name. The mortal necromancer Darkmaster Gandling leads the school and tutors ambitious sorcerers through horrific experiments.

Students who show weakness are cast into the catacombs. In the lower vaults, the voracious wight Ravenian lurks, ready to feed on them.

faq.answer: Scholomance trains mortal spellcasters in the Scourge's dark arts. The secret academy lies deep beneath Caer Darrow, the island fortress.
Ras Frostwhisper oversees Scholomance for the Scourge. Darkmaster Gandling directs instruction and mortal affairs as its ruthless headmaster.

faq.q: How did the Scourge acquire Caer Darrow?
faq.answer: The noble Barov family gave Caer Darrow and its crypts to the Cult of the Damned after Kel'Thuzad promised them eternal life. The cult answered by slaughtering the Barovs and raising them into undeath.
The massive iron gate was sealed to shield the academy's research and summoners from intruders. Opening it requires the Skeleton Key, forged through a complex ritual spanning the Plaguelands.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see Scholomance twist Dalaran's scholastic traditions into necromancy and decay. It shows what Kirin Tor expertise can become in the service of death.
As a paladin of the Silver Hand, cleansing the tainted halls beneath Caer Darrow is an urgent duty. Scholomance is a source of the Scourge's mortal leadership.
